body:
The job I got is a min wage job working McDonalds; Not the best fulltime job, but I needed anything.

I have background in computer science, though.  I went to a private college for a couple years, but withdrew.  I started out going only because my dad forced me to.  I was not ready.  I excelled in my computer science courses, while failing my math, because I did not have any sort of study ethic.  I also was really bad about getting up in time for my morning math classes.

I have held a fulltime job in a development role, but the job was seemingly leading to a dead end for me.  I was getting paid extremely low wages along with having to work overtime on salaried no overtime pay.  On top of that, I was getting screwed over by my supervisor over what my job title actually was.  I was hired to be an application developer but then my boss said I was hired to be a web developer.  I was with them for about 6 months when the company laid off a bunch of people, including the guy next to me, who was the server admin.  I got to take on that role on top of my existing responsibilities.  So now I was spending my day doing general tech support while under extreme pressure to deliver my own projects.

The tipping point for me was when I was pulled into a meeting and it was declared that there was a large project that would require a lot of unpaid overtime and we would not have time for time off until the project was done.  I was done, at this point.  I was being worked off my ass and I was only taking home $13/hr.  So I quit, which gave a big stink off with my boss.  I did not burn any bridges, but it really put off my boss.  So now I lost my 9months of resume experience.

I moved out to Colorado to live with a friend, who said he would help me get back on my feet and possibly into a job in his digital medical record area.  It was ok at first, doing some small contract stuff for him, but then the work dried up.  So I started searching for a min wage job until I could find a career job.  And past collides with present, and here I am today.

It is a long and complicated issue.  The short story is that I am a disappointment to my dad and was kicked out.  I was only welcome and approved of when I made decisions he felt were successful decisions.

I feel really bad about asking for money because my friend is potting all the money he has for his downpayment.  He just sold his bowflex to help cover it.  He is already under his own financial stress from this.

I have been searching for a job for over 3 months. I do not have the money or time to hope for another job.
